scientific_limitations: Closed well-mixed batch; no sources, export, burial, transport or feedback.
Two noninteracting separately conserved classes; strictly positive deposition and resuspension coefficients.
Requires opposing phase-dependent equilibrium differences and consistent strict classwise relaxation-speed order in both phases.
The two phase durations scale proportionally; the ordering objective is terminal suspended mass, not downstream export.
Rates and compositions are illustrative, not empirically fitted; historical priority is provisional.
title: A unique duration-driven reversal in heterogeneous riverbed microplastic exchange
